author: John Hammond
description:
Join John Hammond and Jonny Johnson for Payload Podcast 012 with special guest Yarden Shafir, a security researcher known for her work on Windows internals and exploit mitigations. Join us for a candid conversation about her work and perspective on security research.

Live Friday, October 2, from 12-1 PM Eastern.
title: Payload Podcast 012 - Yarden Shafir

author: John Hammond
description:
I was testing a proof of concept for a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Steam client on a Windows 11 VM.

You still need initial access, but the goal is to elevate from a standard user context to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.

Full video: https://youtu.be/Jx6Jvykqhsk?si=vpPWQFN3Rht5nM3I
title: Steam Privilege Escalation
